lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.
Tourists and locals recount fatal Krakow mass shooting that left Poland reeling, The Associated Press reports.
Collision between 2 trains in Egypt kills 4 and injures 88, The Associated Press reports.

That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
